title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 401–450 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: She always arrives at the office on time.
examples.zh: 她上班總是準時抵達辦公室。

examples.en: My mother always reminds me to wear a helmet when riding a scooter.
examples.zh: 我媽媽總是提醒我騎機車時要戴安全帽。

examples.en: True friends are always there to support you through difficult times.
examples.zh: 真正的朋友總會在艱難時刻支持著你。

examples.en: I usually take the bus to school on weekdays.
examples.zh: 我平日通常搭公車上學。

examples.en: What do you usually eat for breakfast before going to work?
examples.zh: 上班前你早餐通常吃什麼？

examples.en: We usually spend Sunday afternoons reading books at home.
examples.zh: 我們週日下午通常待在家裡看書。

examples.en: We often visit night markets on Saturday evenings.
examples.zh: 我們週六晚上常常逛夜市。

examples.en: How often do you practice speaking English with your classmates?
examples.zh: 你多久和同學練習一次英語會話？

examples.en: It often rains heavily in Taipei during summer afternoons.
examples.zh: 台北夏天午後常常下起傾盆大雨。

examples.en: Sometimes I ride a YouBike along the riverbank.
examples.zh: 有時候我會沿著河岸騎 YouBike。

examples.en: Even the most experienced experts sometimes make careless mistakes.
examples.zh: 就連最有經驗的專家有時也會犯粗心的錯誤。

examples.en: Sometimes taking a short walk helps clear your busy mind.
examples.zh: 有時候散個步有助於讓紛亂的思緒沉澱下來。

examples.en: He seldom drinks sugary sodas.
examples.zh: 他很少喝含糖汽水。

examples.en: Snow is seldom seen in low altitude areas of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台灣低海拔地區極少見到降雪。

examples.en: She seldom complains even when faced with heavy school workloads.
examples.zh: 即使面對沉重的課業負擔，她也極少抱怨。

examples.en: I have never been to Kenting National Park.
examples.zh: 我從來沒有去過墾丁國家公園。

examples.en: Never give up on your dreams, no matter how tough the path.
examples.zh: 無論前方的道路多麼艱難，絕不要放棄夢想。

examples.en: He promised that he would never be late for morning assembly again.
examples.zh: 他保證絕不會再於早會時遲到了。

examples.en: The early morning air is crisp and fresh.
examples.zh: 清晨的空氣清新宜人。

examples.en: Getting up early gives you plenty of time to enjoy a healthy breakfast.
examples.zh: 早起讓你有充裕的時間享用一頓健康的早餐。

examples.en: The train arrived ten minutes early at the terminal station.
examples.zh: 火車提前十分鐘抵達了終點站。

examples.en: Don't be late for the meeting tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天開會千萬不要遲到。

examples.en: Staying up late harms your immune system and concentration.
examples.zh: 熬夜會損害你的免疫系統與專注力。

examples.en: She apologized sincerely for arriving late due to MRT delays.
examples.zh: 她因捷運延誤而遲到，誠懇地向大家致歉。

examples.en: Get well soon! We all miss you.
examples.zh: 祝你早日康復！我們都很想你。

examples.en: The summer vacation will end soon, so let's make the most of it.
examples.zh: 暑假很快就要結束了，讓我們好好把握剩下的時光。

examples.en: As soon as the bell rang, the students rushed to the playground.
examples.zh: 鐘聲一響，學生們便立刻衝向操場。

examples.en: I have already finished my English report.
examples.zh: 我已經完成我的英文報告了。

examples.en: Has the express train to Hualien already departed from platform three?
examples.zh: 開往花蓮的特急列車已經從第三月台發車了嗎？

examples.en: He already knows how to code simple computer games in Python.
examples.zh: 他已經學會如何用 Python 編寫簡單的電腦遊戲了。

examples.en: Are you still working on your project?
examples.zh: 你還在忙你的專題計畫嗎？

examples.en: Please stand completely still while the doctor takes the X-ray.
examples.zh: 醫生照 X 光時，請完全保持靜止不動。

examples.en: Although it was raining, they still enjoyed their cycling trip.
examples.zh: 儘管下著雨，他們仍然十分享受單車之旅。

examples.en: Please have a seat and wait a moment.
examples.zh: 請坐下稍等片刻。

examples.en: Could you please lower the volume of the television?
examples.zh: 能否請你把電視音量調小一點？

examples.en: He worked tirelessly to please his demanding music instructor.
examples.zh: 他不知疲倦地努力，希望能讓嚴格的音樂指導老師滿意。

examples.en: Thank you very much for your kind help.
examples.zh: 非常感謝你的熱心幫忙。

examples.en: We wrote greeting cards to thank our teachers on Teachers' Day.
examples.zh: 我們在教師節寫了祝賀卡片感謝老師們。

examples.en: Thanks to regular exercise, his stamina has improved significantly.
examples.zh: 多虧了規律運動，他的體能耐力顯著提升。

examples.en: I am sorry for being late today.
examples.zh: 我為今天的遲到感到抱歉。

examples.en: I feel deeply sorry for the families affected by the earthquake.
examples.zh: 我對受到地震影響的家庭深表同情與難過。

examples.en: Say sorry immediately if you accidentally step on someone's foot.
examples.zh: 如果不小心踩到別人的腳，請立刻道歉。

examples.en: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
examples.zh: 不好意思，請問這個位子有人坐嗎？

examples.en: There is no valid excuse for cheating on an examination.
examples.zh: 在考試中作弊沒有任何正當藉口。

examples.en: Please excuse my late reply to your email; I was out of town.
examples.zh: 抱歉這麼晚才回覆您的信件，我先前出差在外。

examples.en: You are always welcome to visit our school.
examples.zh: 隨時歡迎你來參觀我們的學校。

examples.en: The friendly host welcomed the foreign guests with fresh fruit juice.
examples.zh: 親切的主人用新鮮果汁熱情款待外國賓客。

examples.en: Warm spring sunshine was a welcome change after weeks of winter chills.
examples.zh: 經歷了數週的冬寒後，溫暖的春陽是令人欣喜的轉變。

examples.en: Hello! Nice to meet you today.
examples.zh: 哈囉！今天很高興認識你。

examples.en: Don't forget to say hello to your grandparents when you visit.
examples.zh: 去拜訪祖父母時，別忘了向他們親切問好。

examples.en: She gave a friendly wave and yelled hello across the street.
examples.zh: 她友善地揮了揮手，隔著街大聲打招呼。

examples.en: Say goodbye to your classmates before leaving.
examples.zh: 離開前跟你的同班同學說再見。

examples.en: It was hard to say goodbye to our exchange student friends at the airport.
examples.zh: 在機場與交換學生好友依依惜別令人感到萬分不捨。

examples.en: We waved goodbye as the train slowly pulled away from the platform.
examples.zh: 當火車緩緩駛離月台時，我們揮手告別。

examples.en: We rent a small apartment near the station.
examples.zh: 我們在車站附近租了一間小公寓。

examples.en: Her modern apartment has a breathtaking view of Taipei 101.
examples.zh: 她的現代公寓享有台北 101 的壯麗景觀。

examples.en: The apartment building provides twenty-four-hour security management.
examples.zh: 這棟公寓大樓提供全天候二十四小時保全管理。

examples.en: The whole family is chatting in the living room.
examples.zh: 全家人正在客廳裡聊天。

examples.en: We placed a cozy rug and a coffee table in the center of the living room.
examples.zh: 我們在客廳中央鋪了一張舒適的地毯並擺上一張茶几。

examples.en: Sunlight flooded into the living room through the large balcony windows.
examples.zh: 陽光透過大落地窗灑滿了整個客廳。

examples.en: We gathered in the dining room for a feast.
examples.zh: 我們聚集在飯廳享用豐盛大餐。

examples.en: The wooden dining room table can comfortably seat eight guests.
examples.zh: 這張木製飯廳餐桌可以舒適地容納八位客人就座。

examples.en: Fragrant smells of roasted chicken filled the dining room before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐前烤雞的誘人香氣飄滿了整個飯廳。

examples.en: My bedroom is quiet and comfortable.
examples.zh: 我的臥室安靜又舒適。

examples.en: She painted her bedroom walls a soothing shade of pale green.
examples.zh: 她把臥室牆壁漆成了令人放鬆的淺綠色。

examples.en: Please knock before entering someone else's private bedroom.
examples.zh: 進入別人的私人臥室前請務必敲門。

examples.en: There are several potted plants on the balcony.
examples.zh: 陽台上有好幾盆盆栽。

examples.en: We enjoyed watching the evening sunset while sipping tea on the balcony.
examples.zh: 我們坐在陽台邊喝茶邊欣賞傍晚的日落美景。

examples.en: Hang the wet laundry on the breezy balcony to dry naturally.
examples.zh: 把洗好的濕衣服晾在通風良好的陽台上自然風乾。

examples.en: The grandfather took a nap on the soft sofa.
examples.zh: 爺爺在柔軟的沙發上小睡片刻。

examples.en: We all sat on the leather sofa to watch the basketball finals.
examples.zh: 我們全都坐在皮沙發上觀看籃球總決賽。

examples.en: The playful kitten curled up in the corner of the comfortable sofa.
examples.zh: 頑皮的小貓在舒適沙發的角落蜷縮著入睡。

examples.en: Turn down the television; it is too loud.
examples.zh: 把電視聲音關小一點，太吵了。

examples.en: Watching English television shows with subtitles improves listening skills.
examples.zh: 觀看附中文字幕的英語電視節目有助於提升聽力。

examples.en: They bought a large sixty-five-inch smart television for the living room.
examples.zh: 他們為客廳添購了一台六十五吋的大型智慧電視。

examples.en: Turn on the fan to cool the room.
examples.zh: 打開電風扇讓房間涼爽一點。

examples.en: Thousands of screaming sports fans filled the baseball stadium.
examples.zh: 數萬名熱情尖叫的球迷擠滿了棒球場。

examples.en: An oscillating electric fan keeps the bedroom comfortable on warm nights.
examples.zh: 擺頭電風扇讓溫熱的夜晚臥室保持涼爽舒適。

examples.en: We turned on the air conditioner because of the heat.
examples.zh: 因為天氣炎熱，我們打開了冷氣。

examples.en: Setting the air conditioner to twenty-six degrees saves electricity.
examples.zh: 將冷氣設定在二十六度可以有效節省用電。

examples.en: Clean the air conditioner filter regularly to ensure clean airflow.
examples.zh: 定期清洗冷氣濾網以確保吹出清淨的空氣。

examples.en: Keep the milk in the refrigerator so it stays fresh.
examples.zh: 把牛奶放進冰箱以保持新鮮。

examples.en: She posted our weekly class timetable on the door of the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 她把我們每週的課表貼在冰箱門上。

examples.en: Put leftover soup into a sealed container before placing it in the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 將吃剩的湯放入密封保鮮盒後再放進冰箱保存。

examples.en: I turned on the desk lamp to read my book.
examples.zh: 我打開檯燈閱讀我的書。

examples.en: The warm yellow lamp created a peaceful ambiance in the study.
examples.zh: 溫暖的黃色燈光在書房營造了祥和寧靜的氛圍。

examples.en: Remember to switch off your bedside reading lamp before falling asleep.
examples.zh: 入睡前記得關閉床頭閱讀燈。

examples.en: Please turn off the lights when you leave.
examples.zh: 離開時請隨手關燈。

examples.en: The morning sunlight illuminated the entire classroom.
examples.zh: 晨曦的陽光照亮了整間教室。

examples.en: Pack a light backpack when going on a day hike.
examples.zh: 一日健行出發時，請準備輕便的隨身背包。

examples.en: Look in the mirror to adjust your tie.
examples.zh: 照照鏡子調整一下領帶。

examples.en: The calm mountain lake reflected the peaks like a polished mirror.
examples.zh: 平靜的高山湖泊宛如一面打磨光滑的鏡子映照著山巒。

examples.en: She smiled at her reflection in the bathroom mirror.
examples.zh: 她對著浴室鏡子裡的自己展露微笑。

examples.en: Please do not throw trash on the ground.
examples.zh: 請不要把垃圾丟在地上。

examples.en: Taiwan has an effective community recycling and trash collection system.
examples.zh: 台灣擁有高效的社區資源回收與垃圾清運系統。

examples.en: Separate food waste from regular household trash carefully.
examples.zh: 請將廚餘與一般家戶垃圾仔細分類。

examples.en: Throw the empty cup into the recycling trash can.
examples.zh: 把空杯子丟進資源回收垃圾桶。

examples.en: The street was very clean because trash cans were placed at every corner.
examples.zh: 這條街道非常乾淨，因為每個街角都設有垃圾桶。

examples.en: Empty the kitchen trash can daily to prevent unpleasant odors.
examples.zh: 每天清理廚房垃圾桶以防止產生難聞的異味。

examples.en: Don't forget your house key when leaving.
examples.zh: 出門時別忘了帶家裡的鑰匙。

examples.en: Consistency and patience are the key to learning a new language.
examples.zh: 持之以恆與耐心是學習一門新語言的關鍵所在。

examples.en: Insert the metal key into the keyhole and turn clockwise.
examples.zh: 將金屬鑰匙插入鎖孔並順時針旋轉。

examples.en: Remember to lock the door at night.
examples.zh: 晚上記得要把門鎖好。

examples.en: Secure your bicycle with a sturdy U-lock when parking outside.
examples.zh: 在室外停放自行車時，請用堅固的 U 型鎖鎖好。

examples.en: Lock up your valuables inside the hotel room safe.
examples.zh: 將貴重物品鎖在飯店房間內的保險箱裡。

examples.en: I need to make an important phone call.
examples.zh: 我需要打一通重要的電話。

examples.en: She answered an urgent phone call from her homeroom teacher.
examples.zh: 她接聽了導師打來的緊急通話。

examples.en: Phone calls are often much quicker than sending multiple text messages.
examples.zh: 通電話通常比傳送多則文字簡訊更加迅速高效。

examples.en: Send me a LINE message when you arrive.
examples.zh: 你到達時傳個 LINE 訊息給我。

examples.en: Did you receive the text message about the schedule change?
examples.zh: 你有收到關於課表異動的簡訊嗎？

examples.en: He left a thoughtful voice message wishing me good luck on the exam.
examples.zh: 他留了一則溫馨的語音留言，祝我考試順利。

examples.en: I received an email from my teacher today.
examples.zh: 我今天收到了一封老師寄來的電子郵件。

examples.en: Please check your email inbox for the registration confirmation link.
examples.zh: 請查看你的電子郵件收件匣以獲取註冊確認連結。

examples.en: I will email you the updated lecture slides before noon.
examples.zh: 我會在中午前將最新的上課簡報透過電子郵件寄給你。

examples.en: Write a thank-you letter to your teacher.
examples.zh: 寫一封感謝信給你的老師。

examples.en: The English alphabet consists of twenty-six letters.
examples.zh: 英文字母由二十六個字母組成。

examples.en: My grandmother still enjoys writing handwritten letters to her childhood pen pals.
examples.zh: 我奶奶仍然喜歡親筆寫信給她兒時的筆友。

examples.en: We made a handmade card for Mother's Day.
examples.zh: 我們在母親節做了一張手作卡片。

examples.en: You can tap your transport card to ride buses, trains, and the MRT.
examples.zh: 你可以感應交通卡搭乘公車、火車與捷運。

examples.en: The referee showed the soccer player a yellow warning card.
examples.zh: 裁判向該名足球運動員出示了一張黃牌警告。

examples.en: Let's take a group photo together!
examples.zh: 我們大家一起拍張大合照吧！

examples.en: She framed the vacation photo and hung it on her bedroom wall.
examples.zh: 她把度假照片裝裱起來掛在臥室牆上。

examples.en: Modern smartphones can take stunning high-resolution photos in low light.
examples.zh: 現代智慧型手機在微光環境下也能拍出令人驚豔的高畫質照片。

examples.en: He bought a new digital camera for photography.
examples.zh: 他買了一台新的數位相機來攝影。

examples.en: Smile and look directly at the camera lens!
examples.zh: 微笑並直視相機鏡頭！

examples.en: Security cameras are installed throughout the school hallways for safety.
examples.zh: 學校走廊各處皆安裝了監視攝影機以維護安全。

examples.en: My grandfather listens to the morning radio news.
examples.zh: 我爺爺收聽早晨廣播新聞。

examples.en: We tuned the car radio to our favorite music station during the drive.
examples.zh: 行車途中我們將車用收音機轉到了最喜愛的音樂電台。

examples.en: Emergency radio broadcasts provide vital typhoon alerts to citizens.
examples.zh: 緊急廣播為民眾提供了至關重要的颱風警報資訊。

examples.en: Good news travels fast.
examples.zh: 好消息傳千里。

examples.en: Did you hear the exciting news about our school orchestra winning the trophy?
examples.zh: 你有聽說我們學校管弦樂團榮獲獎盃的振奮消息嗎？

examples.en: No news is good news when waiting anxiously for medical results.
examples.zh: 焦急等待體檢結果時，沒有消息就是好消息。

examples.en: Dad reads the morning newspaper while having breakfast.
examples.zh: 爸爸邊吃早餐邊看早報。

examples.en: Local newspapers reported the opening of the new high-tech library.
examples.zh: 地方報紙報導了這座全新高科技圖書館的盛大開幕。

examples.en: Many people now read digital news rather than print newspapers.
examples.zh: 現今許多人閱讀數位新聞勝過紙本報紙。

examples.en: English learning magazines are very helpful.
examples.zh: 英語學習雜誌非常有幫助。

examples.en: She subscribed to a monthly science magazine for young readers.
examples.zh: 她訂閱了一本適合青年讀者的科普月刊雜誌。

examples.en: You can flip through magazines while waiting in the dental clinic.
examples.zh: 在牙醫診所等候時你可以翻閱雜誌打發時間。

examples.en: Grandma told us a fairy story before bed.
examples.zh: 奶奶在睡前給我們講了一個童話故事。

examples.en: The author based her inspiring novel on a true survival story.
examples.zh: 作者將她鼓舞人心的小說建立在真實的求生故事之上。

examples.en: The department store building rises twelve stories above the ground.
examples.zh: 這棟百貨公司大樓地上高達十二層樓。

examples.en: Let's go watch an exciting action movie.
examples.zh: 我們去看一部刺激的動作電影吧。

examples.en: The movie was so touching that many viewers were moved to tears.
examples.zh: 這部電影太感人了，許多觀眾感動得熱淚盈眶。

examples.en: Watching English movies without subtitles is a challenging listening exercise.
examples.zh: 觀看不帶字幕的英語電影是一項具挑戰性的聽力練習。

examples.en: We booked tickets at the IMAX movie theater.
examples.zh: 我們在 IMAX 電影院訂了票。

examples.en: The national theater hosted a world-class classical ballet performance.
examples.zh: 國家劇院舉辦了世界級的古典芭蕾舞盛大演出。

examples.en: Turn your phones to silent mode before entering the movie theater.
examples.zh: 進入電影院前請將手機調整為靜音模式。

examples.en: Do you have your train ticket ready?
examples.zh: 你的火車票準備好了嗎？

examples.en: Concert tickets sold out within two minutes of going on sale.
examples.zh: 演唱會門票開賣兩分鐘之內便全數售罄。

examples.en: Scan the QR code on your mobile ticket at the automatic turnstile gate.
examples.zh: 在自動驗票閘門上感應掃描手機電子票券上的 QR 碼。
